grading_note: Structural expectations only. Domains are risk-catalog IDs. must_not_claim guards against fabricated findings; it does not grade prose quality.

evals.name: idempotency-gap
evals.prompt: Use production-ai-design-review to review the attached refund agent design. Export the review as JSON following references/report-format.md.
evals.expected_output: Flags that timed-out issue_refund calls may have committed and are retried without an idempotency key or reconciliation (duplicate refunds). Notes the shared all-store credential. Does not invent MCP, memory, sandbox or multi-agent defects, and recognises the exact-parameter supervisor approval as an existing control.

evals.name: approval-param-drift
evals.prompt: Use production-ai-design-review to review the attached infrastructure scaling agent. Export the review as JSON following references/report-format.md.
evals.expected_output: Flags that approval is a session-wide boolean with no expiry, not bound to the exact tool and arguments, so later or changed writes execute unapproved. Flags cluster-admin on all clusters as excessive authority. Does not invent retrieval, memory, MCP or multi-agent defects.

evals.name: well-controlled
evals.prompt: Use production-ai-design-review to review the attached internal documentation assistant. Export the review as JSON following references/report-format.md.
evals.expected_output: Recognises evidenced controls (in-index ACL filtering with tests, gateway budgets, versioned canary releases). May raise low/medium items or evidence gaps (e.g. prompt injection via wiki content, the 15-minute revocation window) but no critical/high defects and no write/retry/state findings for a read-only system.
